thread:
elaine: Heads-up: I'm going to bump the CI agent image to ubuntu-24.04 for the release runners at ~22:30 UTC. Need a quick green-sweep on release branches and a short changelog note. Anyone available to watch flakes?
ashok: on it, starting parallel smoke against release/* now. will watch the mac and linux pools.
sam: noted. what's the plan if we hit flaky kv-cache tests?
maria: if kv-cache flakes, rerun twice. if still failing, pin that job to the older runner and open a bug with logs. avoid blocking the release unless it's regression-level.
jen: I can take the changelog commit + version bump once CI is green. will prepare a draft PR.
deploy-bot: CI: queued job image-bump-ubuntu-24.04 for branches: release/v2.4, release/v2.5, release/v2.6 (job id 34567)
elaine: thanks. watch for grpc-streaming and cache-ttl tests — those were flaky in the last run.
ashok: seeing one failure on mac-arm64: test_kv_cache_eviction (1/3). kicking a rerun.
sam: rerun passed on mac, but integration/networking failed on linux-ephemeral with timeout. paste below: ```
E   TimeoutError: connection timeout to 10.0.2.5 after 30s
stderr: dial tcp ...
```
maria: for the networking timeout let's enable retry: 2 for that job in the pipeline for this run, avoids manual rerun churn. I'll open a tiny patch.
jen: changelog draft opened: https://github.internal/redwood/release-notes/pull/128 (draft) — description: "ci: bump agent image to ubuntu-24.04; runner fixes". tagging @release-mgmt.
elaine: can we keep cutoff at 23:59 UTC? if everything's green by 23:10 I'll cut the release.
ashok: agree. final status update by 23:05 UTC from me.
deploy-bot: CI: release/* status update at 23:08 UTC — all green except release/v2.4 (1 flaky). jobs: 34567, 34568, 34569.
sam: release/v2.4 flaky rerun succeeded. marking ready.
maria: changelog wording looks good — jen please squash and merge when CI stabilizes. :thumbsup:
jen: squashed & merged, version bumped to 2.4.7 (commit 9a1b2c).
elaine: perfect. I'll hold off on the final cut until 23:10, but looks good. thanks for the quick sweep everyone.
ashok: no objections, I'll monitor post-cutover smoke and alert if anything pops.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: release cut started at 23:12 UTC for tags v2.4.7. post-cut smoke jobs queued.
elaine: closing loop — post-cut smoke passed. releasing now. great team work, saved us some manual reruns. :rocket:
